name: Knot Polynomial Spaces: A Benchmark for Rare-Event Evaluation in AI for Math
description: A reproducible benchmark for rare-event evaluation in AI for Math using aligned coefficient encodings of the Alexander, Jones, and HOMFLY--PT polynomials for prime knots. The benchmark evaluates bulk accessibility and fixed-mass tail enrichment using the knot signature as a held-out external evaluation probe. The repository provides preprocessing, alignment, split generation, model training, scoring, and evaluation scripts. Processed benchmark arrays and result artifacts are not redistributed in the repository; they can be regenerated from the public raw knotsBM Zenodo release.
citation: Anonymous authors. Knot Polynomial Spaces: A Benchmark for Rare-Event Evaluation in AI for Math. Submitted for review, 2026.

distribution.name: Raw knotsBM data
distribution.description: Public raw knot polynomial coefficient data used as the source for benchmark construction.

distribution.name: Benchmark code repository
distribution.description: Code for preprocessing, alignment, split generation, reconstruction model training, scoring, and evaluation.

hasPart.name: Data preparation and alignment script
hasPart.description: Script that aligns Alexander, Jones, and HOMFLY--PT coefficient tables, removes mirror entries, checks signature consistency, creates fixed splits, and stores train-only standardization metadata.

hasPart.name: Reconstruction model training script
hasPart.description: Script that trains PCA and autoencoder reconstruction models for Alexander, Jones, and HOMFLY--PT coefficient spaces without using signature labels.

hasPart.name: Bulk signature decoding script
hasPart.description: Script that evaluates bulk accessibility of knot signature from raw coefficients, PCA embeddings, and autoencoder latents using a post hoc multinomial logistic regression probe.

hasPart.name: Rare-event tail enrichment script
hasPart.description: Script that evaluates fixed-mass top-k tail enrichment, tail recall, and captured counts for rare large-signature targets.

hasPart.name: Paper table generation script
hasPart.description: Script that generates paper tables from benchmark outputs.

variableMeasured.name: number_of_crossings
variableMeasured.description: Crossing number of the knot, used for alignment metadata, controls, and out-of-distribution diagnostics.

variableMeasured.name: is_alternating
variableMeasured.description: Indicator of whether the knot is alternating, used for alignment metadata.

variableMeasured.name: table_number
variableMeasured.description: Table identifier used to align records across polynomial coefficient files.

variableMeasured.name: sigma
variableMeasured.description: Knot signature. This variable is held out from unsupervised training and used only as an external evaluation probe.

variableMeasured.name: alexander_coefficients
variableMeasured.description: Fixed-dimensional coefficient vector encoding of the Alexander polynomial. Dimension: 17.

variableMeasured.name: jones_coefficients
variableMeasured.description: Fixed-dimensional coefficient vector encoding of the Jones polynomial. Dimension: 51.

variableMeasured.name: homfly_pt_coefficients
variableMeasured.description: Fixed-dimensional coefficient vector encoding of the HOMFLY--PT polynomial. Dimension: 152.

variableMeasured.name: split
variableMeasured.description: Train, validation, or test assignment generated by the fixed benchmark split protocol.

variableMeasured.name: Y12
variableMeasured.description: Extreme rare-event target defined as 1[|sigma(K)| >= 12]. Used only as a qualitative stress test.

measurementTechnique: Coefficient table alignment by number_of_crossings, is_alternating, and table_number
Mirror filtering for entries marked with !
Signature consistency filtering across polynomial files
Shared train, validation, and test split indices across polynomial invariants
Rare-event tail recall and captured-count evaluation
Confounder controls using coefficient norm, support width, sparsity proxy, and crossing number
conditionsOfAccess: The raw data are public and available through the knotsBM Zenodo release. The repository does not redistribute processed benchmark arrays or result artifacts by default. Processed arrays, splits, scores, tables, and figures can be regenerated from the public raw data using the provided scripts.
intendedUse: This benchmark is intended for evaluating unsupervised representation learning methods and reconstruction-based scoring rules under a bulk-versus-tail protocol. It supports evaluation of bulk signature accessibility, fixed-mass rare-event tail enrichment, representation-dependent compressibility failure, and sensitivity to alternative evaluation choices.
limitations: Polynomial invariants are not complete knot invariants. Rare large-signature events are extremely imbalanced. The benchmark is bounded by the available crossing number range in the underlying public dataset. Tail membership is representation- and score-dependent and should not be interpreted as an intrinsic topological anomaly label.
ethicalConsiderations: The benchmark consists of mathematical objects and does not contain human subjects, personal data, demographic attributes, behavioral data, or deployed decision-making outcomes. No direct negative societal impacts are anticipated.

outOfScopeUses: Treating reconstruction tails as intrinsic topological anomaly labels
Using the benchmark to claim universal detector optimality
Using Y12 as a statistically stable quantitative target
knownLimitations: Polynomial coefficient vectors are incomplete representations of knots
Crossing number range is bounded by the source dataset
Processed assets must be regenerated from the public source data unless separately distributed
